{"metadata":{"description":"Improve web search in Deepseek Harness, use server-side search service.","id":"gh:1333826692","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-search-provider","slug":"hiyms/dsh-web-search-provider","topics":["ai","ai-tools","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Improve web search in Deepseek Harness, use server-side search service."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-search-provider"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Network search support for the Deepseek Harness, powered by the model provider's server-side capabil"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ork search support for the Deepseek Harness, powered by the model provider's server-side capability."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Using this plugin requires the model provider to use the **OpenAI Responses API** or an **Anthropic-"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"compatible Messages API**, and to **provide a web search capability**."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> [!TIP]
> The Anthropic-compatible Messages API only provides a search capability, while the OpenAI"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" Responses API additionally supports viewing a URL's page content / finding specific content within "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"a URL's page. **Providers on the OpenAI Responses API are recommended.**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> [!TIP]
> Verified to work with: the Deepseek official Messages API (the DSH built-in Deepseek prov"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ider), the OpenCode Go Messages API, the OpenCode Go Response API, and an OpenAI relay station's Res"},{"id":"p7s3","text":" OpenCode Go Messages API, the OpenCode Go Response API, and an OpenAI relay station's Response API."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> The DSH built-in OpenCode Go provider uses different API types for different models. "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"For example, for its Deepseek V4 Flash/Pro models, to use this plugin's capability you need to manua"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"lly add a custom provider of the Response / Message API type."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> Some model providers may charge extra for the web search capability this plugin uses."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This plugin does not provide its support through the `web_search` tool inside the Deepseek Harness, "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"so you can use it alongside other web search provider plugins (such as the built-in `web-search-deep"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"can use it alongside other web search provider plugins (such as the built-in `web-search-deepseek`)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Comparing with web-search-deepseek"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"> TL;DR Compared with `web-search-deepseek`, this plugin has a clear advantage in both token consump"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ed with `web-search-deepseek`, this plugin has a clear advantage in both token consumption and time."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"`web-search-deepseek` is the Deepseek Harness's built-in search plugin: when the model in a session "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"calls the `web_search` tool, it creates a new internal session to run the search and returns several"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" URLs with their content summaries."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Compared with `web-search-deepseek`, the AI in this plugin's sessions sends the network search reque"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"st directly to the server, making **each individual search faster**. Also, the model can directly vi"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ew / search page content (only with the **OpenAI Responses API**), reducing the tokens the AI spends"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" on bash/curl to read a page's full content."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Using the Deepseek official Messages API's `deepseek-v4-flash model with high think`, each plugin pe"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"rformed 5 specified searches per run, tested 10 times:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Plugin | Average tokens | Average time |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| web-search-deepseek | 4,446 | 47.5s"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" |
| **web-search-provider** | **822** | **14.5s** |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Time is measured from the answer duration shown in the Deepseek Harness. Tokens are the average of t"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"he "output" tokens reported on the Deepseek Open Platform, using two different API tokens (because t"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"he Deepseek Harness does not count tokens consumed inside tool calls)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The results are for reference only. On tasks that need more web search content, this plugin is expec"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ted to show a more pronounced advantage."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Or install from source:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Reference the built plugin from a `cordis.yml` overlay:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Settings section `web-search-provider` (a live namespace: edits reach the next request). All fields "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"are optional unless noted."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; `false` sends every request down the normal adapter path. |
| "},{"id":"p28s2","text":"`providers` | `[]` | Provider whitelist (llm-pi-ai route keys). A request is served only when its pr"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ovider is also the current chat route (the plan derives its endpoint facts from that route); the whi"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"telist restricts which of its providers may be served. Empty = serve the current chat route. |
| `ba"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"seURL` | route | Endpoint base override for the route's candidates; `/responses` or `/messages` is a"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"ppended. |
| `model` | loop model | Model override; used by the capability probe and by the served w"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"ire request. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | route ref | Credential reference resolved per operation. |
| `include"},{"id":"p28s8","text":"Sources` | `true` | Append `include: ['web_search_call.action.sources']` to Responses wire requests."},{"id":"p28s9","text":" |
| `stripServerTools` | `true` | Strip the function-tool variants (`web_search`/`open_page`/`find_"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"in_page`) from the wire tools. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Idle bound for one inline request, i"},{"id":"p28s11","text":"n milliseconds. |
| `probe` | `true` | Verify the endpoint executes native search before serving. |
"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"| `probeTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Bound on one probe request, in milliseconds. |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- For providers that use the Response API / Message API **but do not provide a search capability**, "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"the session **errors on first use**. Keep sending messages / open a new session and DSH keeps workin"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"g without this plugin's capability.
- When the AI uses this plugin's web search capability, there is"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" **no visible search-call UI**. The usage may appear as multiple consecutive thinking segments, with"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" the tail of a thinking segment containing something like "*Let me make search queries*"."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Contributing"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Building"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"}],"truncated":false}
